icons.name: menu
icons.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: production toolbar icon for MarkVibe, a Windows Markdown reader. Create exactly ONE standalone icon, not an icon sheet or UI screenshot. Style: crisp modern Fluent-inspired duotone, softly rounded geometric forms, very subtle depth, saturated azure blue and teal with small warm amber accents, generous uncluttered silhouette. Must remain immediately recognizable at 24x24 pixels on both near-white and dark navy surfaces. Center the full icon with consistent safe padding, occupying about 76 percent of the square canvas. True transparent alpha background. No surrounding button tile, no frame, no border, no cast shadow on the background, no text labels, no watermark. Square composition. Subject: a sidebar layout symbol: a rounded rectangular window divided into a narrow left navigation column and wide right content area

sidebar.name: 01-fluent-tabs
sidebar.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Edit target: the attached screenshot of the MarkVibe sidebar. Produce a polished, realistic design proposal for this exact sidebar area, replacing its current visual treatment. Keep the recognizable vertical sidebar geometry and roles: workspace heading, workspace subtitle, Pages and Outline selector, scrollable document list, bottom local page count. Use native-looking Windows 11 Desktop Acrylic throughout the sidebar: softly frosted transparent glass showing blurred blue, teal and lavender background shapes behind, legible dark text. Absolutely no perimeter border around the sidebar. The actual reading document, glimpsed to the right, stays opaque white. Replace the two old buttons with genuine tab-page headers, active Pages and inactive Outline. Use synthetic example document titles only: Documentation, Getting started, Reading guide, Exporting documents, Handwritten notes, Appearance. Filename labels README.md, guide/start.md, guide/reading.md, guide/export.md, guide/ink.md, guide/appearance.md. Exact visible main labels: 'docs', 'Local folder · notes beside Markdown', 'Pages', 'Outline', '29 pages · on this device'. High fidelity, restrained modern UI, no watermark, no extra explanatory labels outside the UI. Variant: Fluent underline tabs: Pages and Outline are two genuine flat text tabs with a colored thin underline under Pages. A quiet transparent tab strip, generous list spacing, and a softly tinted rounded selected document row.

about.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide hero banner for the MarkVibe About dialog, inspired by the reference WorkTrail banner. Reference image role: visual style and composition only. Create an original 3:1 landscape illustration with deep midnight blue terrain, a subtle mountain landscape, and a softly glowing lilac path linking small warm ivory sculptural symbols of reading and notes: an open book, a document with handwritten pen strokes, and a paper export sheet with a small downward arrow. Keep the left 42 percent quiet, dark and low contrast so the app can overlay its title in white. Place the linked objects on the right. Refined miniature 3D art, subdued blue/lilac, restrained soft illumination, no words, no letters, no watermarks, no app screenshot. Preserve the reference's calm, premium mood without the clock or task app symbols.
